# Rule 3- No Hate Speech [bold]There is a zero-tolerance policy on hate speech[/bold]. Bigots are not welcome here.
Any form of discrimination, persecution, or deliberate incitement against another player, and any use of slogans, symbols, or rhetoric associated with hate movements will result in an immediate ban.
## OOC Interactions Any attack against another player on the basis of their gender, sexuality, ethnicity, or lived experience falls under this rule. Malicious or offensive use of slurs, as well as hateful dogwhistles and slogans will be treated with absolutely minimal leniency.
This is not a ban against referencing the existence of hate groups or hate speech IC or OOC, but any glorification will immediately fall under this rule. You should also be mindful not to force OOC groups and beliefs into the IC world.
Please refrain from using this rule's existence to argue about political or social matters, and do not interpret this rule in bad faith. Violations will be identified and dealt with by admins directly.
## IC Discrimination You are allowed to play an intolerant or judgemental character, but you may not directly link your character to hateful or discriminatory beliefs and/or movements. Examples of what is and is not allowed are as follows. - You MAY play a character who judges their coworkers by age, nationality, or planet of origin as long as that judgment does not result in obstruction of work or violence. - You MAY make jokes about a character's species, gender, or appearance so long as they are within reason and do not become excessive or discriminatory. - You MAY NOT play a far-right extremist of any sort, nor any character whose design or mannerisms allude to real-world discriminatory movements. - You MAY NOT discriminate against characters on the basis of their species, gender, base appearance, or language usage for any reason whatsoever.
